text:
jon: quick sync - updating the 'first deployment' quickstart. Found two issues: the TypeScript example uses the old callback API, and the "deploy to Docker" step references `docker run -e RW_KEY=...` which we no longer recommend. I'll open a small PR.

elaine: thanks. can you also swap the JS example to show the streaming call? folks often ask how to stream token updates.

jon: yep planning to add an ultra-minimal streaming snippet with the new client API. Proposed JS snippet:

```js
import RedwoodClient from '@redwood/inference';
const c = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
const stream = await c.stream('Write a haiku about launch days');
for await (const chunk of stream) console.log(chunk.text);
```

mike: tiny nit: use RW_API_KEY in env examples everywhere. Also please don't show copying key into source files. security :grimacing:.

jon: good catch, will update. For Docker step I'll replace RW_KEY with RW_API_KEY and change the run to `docker run -e RW_API_KEY=... ghcr.io/redwood-inference/runner:stable`. I'll also add a short note: "Prefer sandboxed CI secrets over inline envs".

elaine: can you add a one-line migration note for folks still using the callback pattern? Something like: "If you used client.on('data', ...) before, switch to async iteration via stream()".

jon: will do. creating PR now.

docs-bot: PR created by jon -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/451 (quickstart: streaming example + env rename) :robot_face:

mike: I'll review and add a small test that imports the example file in the docs CI to ensure it compiles. follow-up PR ok?

jon: yes please. merging after CI green.

docs-bot: PR merged by jon into main (CI: green). Staging docs updated.

elaine: Thanks all. I'll add a localization note so translations update the env var string.

mike: sweet. closing the loop.
